title: Two more ways to earn Pollen
summary:
New Pollen Quests, a Berlin AI Night page and a CatGPT upgrade arrived alongside 27 community apps and less misleading stream timings.

Two BYOP Quests were added: people can earn 0.25 Pollen for logging in through an app, and app owners can earn 7 Pollen when an external user logs in through their app’s authorization flow. Qualifying activity can be credited when quests are checked.

A page was added for the free AI Night on 16 July in Berlin, with a show-and-tell, a real-or-fake game, a robot DJ and an email RSVP. The team also added social artwork in several formats. Software now has a flyer.

The Discord comic bot now checks recent channel messages on startup and answers up to five unanswered questions. A new `ask` command generates and posts a comic directly; comic generation also uses a durable selfie reference and `nanobanana-2-lite`.
